auth.checkEmailDesc: We sent you a sign-in link. Check your inbox and your spam folder.
auth.sendError: We couldn't send the email. Please try again in a moment.
auth.rateLimited: Too many links requested. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
auth.asDriver: You're signing up as a driver or carrier. Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link.
auth.asShipper: You're signing up to find transport. Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in link.

vehicles.title: My Vehicles
vehicles.cargoHelp: Approximate size of the largest space (rear seats folded, pickup bed or van box). Adjust it if your vehicle is different.
vehicles.approx: Approximate catalog values — please check them.
vehicles.welcomeDriver: Welcome! Step 1: add your vehicle below. Step 2: in Profile, request driver verification. Once approved you can post trips.
vehicles.otherModel: My model is not listed (type it)
vehicles.manualHelp: Type your vehicle's model and measurements. Approximate values are fine.
vehicles.plateHelp: The plate is private: only the admin and the customer of a paid trip see it, so they can recognise your vehicle.

trip.noVehicles: First add a vehicle in My Vehicles.
trip.offerIntro: Post when and where you will be available. Example: on October 10 I'll be in Omaha from 10:00 to 11:00 am and can go to Lincoln, or wherever the customer needs.
trip.whereWhen: Where and when are you available?
trip.windowHelp: The time range in which you can leave or pick up. Choosing the start fills the end with one hour later; you can change it.
trip.maxTripMilesHelp: Leave empty if you have no limit.
trip.rateTripHelp: What you charge for the whole trip. The customer can propose another price.
trip.ratePerMileHelp: Example: $1.50 per mile × 60 miles = $90. You agree the final price with the customer.
trip.anyDestInfo: This driver goes wherever the customer needs. Priced per mile, agreed according to the destination.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check the data and try again.
errors.date_past: The start date can't be in the past.
errors.date_too_far: The date can't be more than a year ahead.
errors.window_too_long: The date range can't be longer than 14 days.
errors.outside_nebraska: For now the origin or destination must be in Nebraska.
errors.seats_invalid: Seats must be a whole number, from 1 up to your vehicle's seats.
errors.vehicle_no_seats: This vehicle has no passenger seats.
errors.weight_over_payload: Weight can't exceed your vehicle's max payload.
errors.weight_invalid: Weight must be between 1 and 80,000 lb.
errors.dims_invalid: Check the dimensions (length up to 720, width up to 120, height up to 160 in).
errors.pieces_invalid: Number of pieces must be a whole number.
errors.invalid_option: One of the options is not valid.
errors.driver_not_verified: You need to be a verified driver.
errors.offer_closed: This offer is no longer active.
errors.request_closed: This request is no longer open.
errors.self_deal: You can't make a deal with yourself.
errors.review_not_completed: Only completed trips can be rated.
errors.review_window_closed: The rating period (30 days) has ended.
errors.account_suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact the Collage Transport team.
errors.account_payment_hold: Your account is on hold for a pending payment. You can't post or close new deals until it's settled.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.cannot_modify_admin: An admin's status can't be changed.
errors.has_deals: It has deals: cancel it instead of deleting.
errors.alert_limit: You reached the limit of 20 active alerts. Delete or pause one.
errors.alert_empty: Set at least an origin or destination for the alert.
errors.onboarding_intent: Choose at least one: I need transport or I offer transport.
errors.vehicle_capacity_required: Seats, cargo measurements or maximum weight are missing.
errors.miles_invalid: Maximum distance must be between 5 and 2000 miles.
errors.rate_per_mile_invalid: Price per mile must be between $0.10 and $50.

board.offersSubtitle: Drivers with seats or cargo space available. Click a row to see the details.
board.requestsSubtitle: People and loads looking for a driver. Filter by your vehicle to see only what fits.
board.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
board.milesNote: Approximate miles (straight line × 1.2). DH-O = distance from the city you searched to the origin.
board.newRows: {count, plural, one {# new request} other {# new requests}} match your filters — show
board.liveHint: Checking for new requests every 30 seconds.
board.alertRequests: Email me new requests like these
board.alertOffers: Email me when a trip like this appears

reviews.title: Rating
reviews.commentPlaceholder: Comment (optional): punctuality, manners, condition of the cargo...
reviews.moderationNote: Stars count in the average once both of you rate or 14 days pass. The comment is published after our team reviews it.
reviews.blind: You'll see the other person's rating once they rate too (or in 14 days).
reviews.closed: This deal can no longer be rated.

account.payment_hold: Your account is on hold for a pending payment. You can finish trips in progress but can't post or close new deals. Contact the team to settle it.
account.suspended: Your account is suspended. Contact the Collage Transport team.

alerts.title: My alerts
alerts.help: We email you when something matching is posted. At most one email every 3 hours per alert; they switch off when the dates pass.
alerts.fromRequestBtn: Email me when a matching trip appears
alerts.unsubscribed: Done, you won't get emails from that alert anymore.
alerts.unsubscribedInvalid: That link is no longer valid.

onboarding.intro: Tell us what you want to do so we show you what's useful. You can change it later in your profile.
onboarding.q1: What do you want to do?
onboarding.shipText: Travel to another city or send packages, furniture, goods or a move.
onboarding.driveText: I have a car, pickup, van, truck or trailer and want to carry passengers or cargo.
onboarding.q2: Will you use the account as a person or a business?
onboarding.companyShipText: A business that needs to ship cargo or move employees.
onboarding.companyDriveText: A transport, moving or courier company with one or more vehicles.
onboarding.companyNameHelp: This is the name other users will see.
onboarding.nameHelp: This is the name others will see (for example: Maria G.).
onboarding.phoneHelp: Only shared with the other person once the trip is paid.
onboarding.usdotHelp: It helps customers trust you. Our team reviews it.
onboarding.driverNext: Next step: add your vehicle and request driver verification (license, insurance and inspection). Once approved you can post trips.

dash.welcome: All set! Your account is ready.
dash.stepVerified: Verified driver: you can post trips
dash.stepBrowseRequests: See requests that fit your vehicle
dash.stepPostRequest: Post what you need (ride or cargo)
dash.stepAlert: Turn on an alert so we email you
